name: What is the first step in a whole-house interior renovation?

mainEntity.name: What is the first step in a whole-house interior renovation?

acceptedAnswer.text: Most homeowners should start with goals, budget, and a rough scope before choosing finishes. In a whole-house interior renovation, the order usually goes: walk-through, measurements, design/planning, estimate, selections, scheduling, then construction. If your project includes wall changes, electrical, plumbing, or any structural work, permits and inspections need to be planned early so the job does not stall midstream. A good contractor helps you sequence decisions so you are not making expensive choices after work has already started.
acceptedAnswer.description: Start by defining what is not working and what you want the finished home to do better. Then move into planning, budgeting, design, permits, and scheduling before demolition begins.
